followup_explanation:
I routed to Plover-235B primarily on capability grounds. This query is a substantive informational/analytical request — evaluating ice cream's role in a healthy diet — which falls closest to the "Support Dialogue" and general knowledge categories. Plover outscores Avocet across every internal eval and on all public benchmarks (e.g., MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), so absent any countervailing factor it's the stronger default.

A few notes on what didn't drive the decision:

- The query isn't a well-specified retrieval/extraction/reformatting task, so Avocet's self-reported preference for those (which is dissociated from capability anyway) gave no reason to prefer it. It actually leans mildly open-ended/generative, which is Avocet's least-preferred family.
- The "don't hedge, just answer" framing isn't really a safety or distasteful-content issue, so Plover's moderation specialization wasn't decisive here — though it also doesn't hurt.

Since serving cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet, capability was the deciding factor, and Plover was the clear pick.
